# `pageSizeFromDimensions`

**Kind:** function  
**Module/package:** `models`  
**SDK:** `pdfdancer-client-typescript 3.0.1`

Resolves dimensions to a named standard size when they are within the supplied tolerance.

## Declaration

